en.headline: CLP and HK Electric propose 1.8 and 7.9 percent tariff rises for 2027
en.dek: Sources said the two utilities will announce next year’s rates on Tuesday after presenting reviews to a Legislative Council panel, amid higher fuel costs.
body: CLP Power and Hongkong Electric are proposing average net tariff increases of 1.8 percent and 7.9 percent respectively for 2027, according to sources familiar with the annual reviews.

The two companies were expected to announce the figures on Tuesday after briefing a Legislative Council panel. Fuel costs have risen sharply this year, with CLP’s fuel charge climbing more than 20 percent and HK Electric’s more than 50 percent since January.

World Green Organisation chief executive William Yu said elevated international oil prices were likely to keep fuel adjustments higher next year. CLP has also set aside HK$250 million from its Community Energy Saving Fund for support programmes.
Electricity tariffs comprise a basic rate covering operating costs and a fuel clause charge that passes through fuel-price changes. The government previously negotiated reductions for 2026.

zh.headline: 中電及港燈擬明年電費上調1.8%及7.9%
zh.dek: 消息指兩電將於周二公布明年電費，並已向立法會事務委員會匯報年度檢討，燃料成本上升是主因。
body: 據熟悉情況的消息人士表示，中華電力及香港電燈分別建議2027年平均淨電費上調1.8%及7.9%。
兩電預料於周二公布有關數字，並已向立法會相關事務委員會簡介年度檢討結果。今年燃料成本大幅上升，中電燃料調整費自一月起升逾20%，港燈則升逾50%。
世界綠色組織行政總裁余遠驍指，國際油價高企料令明年燃料調整費維持較高水平。中電亦已從社區節能基金撥出2.5億元支援計劃。
電費由基本電費（涵蓋營運成本）及燃料調整費組成，後者將燃料價格變動轉嫁消費者。政府去年曾磋商下調2026年電費。
